notes: No fiction found, nothing removed. Separate: turkish resorts are towns, not regions; peninsulas are stored as bare adjectives (Iberian, Korean, Olympic) that make no sense as 'famous natural features'; antarctic places includes research stations (McMurdo, Rothera, Scott Base); ancient cities are mostly ruins (Ur, Ebla, Nineveh) that would read oddly in a modern 'cities' level. Kept plain where English usage is plain: Quebec, Izmir, Fez, Aragon, Galapagos, Grossglockner, Hawaiian names without okina. Kept official no-apostrophe names: Devils Tower, Kings Canyon, Pikes Peak, Surfers Paradise. Turkish resorts now use Turkish letters (Kuşadası, İçmeler, Çeşme...). K2 added to famous mountains, not himalayan peaks (it is in the Karakoram). Mountain ranges has both Elburz and Alborz (same range) from the first pass; left as is.
